title: OfflinePassIssuanceRequest
description: HTTP request body sent by the mobile app to the server's pass issuance endpoint (POST /api/v1/offline/passes) per spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3. Carries the device key the server binds into the pass. The server's response is defined by offline-pass-issuance-response.schema.json.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device requesting the pass. Copied into the pass's deviceId.

devicePublicKey.description: The P-256 public key of the device key, compressed SEC1, Base64: a key pair the app generated in the phone's hardware-backed keystore with a non-exportable private key (spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3.2). Copied into the pass's devicePublicKey.
